name: visual-review
description: The /visual-review command shows the design of the changes against a base branch as a diagram in the browser: classes and modules with their relations, size and quality notes, and the database tables. Comment on the diagram and send the review back to the session in one step.

analysisModel.title: Model of the design analysis
analysisModel.description: The model of the subagent that reads the diff and returns the design model for the diagram. inherit uses the model of the session. Each /visual-review run starts 1 analysis.
